name: Wandering Peddler
what: A colourful peddler with a pack llama sells rare goods for Coins by the Banner.
you: Talk to him and buy what you need; he only takes Coins and stays about a day.

name: Refugees
what: A family of three waits at the Banner and asks for shelter.
you: Take them in as settlers, give food, ask them to work, or send them away.

name: Travelling Minstrels
what: Three minstrels arrive at the Tavern at dusk.
you: Host a feast for a full set (costs Coins) or let them play for tips; listeners wake happier.

name: Fox in the Fields
what: A fox sneaks into your fields and steals ripe crops.
you: Chase it off; your Farmer runs out and a Hunter can shoot it to drop the crop.

name: Wolf Pack
what: Three wolves come for your livestock at night.
you: Guards fight them; the pack leaves after one kill or two losses and is gone by dawn.

name: Wild Boar
what: A bad-tempered boar roots up crops in your fields.
you: Let Guards fight it or have a Hunter shoot it for extra meat.

name: Tavern Brawl
what: Two settlers fall out over ale and come to blows (no real damage).
you: Right-click a brawler to break it up, or a Guard will; each ending costs a little morale.
needs: a Tavern and 2 civilians near it

name: Brute Toll
what: Three brutes walk up to the Banner and demand food.
you: Pay food or 10 Coins, talk them down, refuse or attack; answer within about 2 hours.

name: Stray Dog
what: A scruffy dog hangs around the Banner.
you: Feed it and it becomes the village dog for good, or shoo it away.
needs: 2+ settlers and no village dog yet

name: Passing Caravan
what: A trade caravan stops on the road near town.
you: Barter in bulk, escort it to its far waypoint for Coins and goods, or wave it on.

name: Rival Envoy
what: An envoy of a neighbouring lord comes to the Banner.
you: Negotiate a trade pact, send a gift, insult him or dismiss him; the lord remembers.

name: Barter Table
what: A bare barter screen opened directly on an NPC with trade stock.
you: Pick goods on both sides and accept the deal, or leave.

name: Brute Toll (talk)
what: The brute chief demands a toll of food.
you: Pay food or Coins, try to talk them down (Intimidation), refuse, or attack.

name: Caravan (talk)
what: The caravan master offers trade or asks for an escort.
you: Barter, agree to escort them past the woods, or let them pass.

name: Demo Peddler
what: A test peddler conversation for admins.
you: Only spawned by the /hstalk admin command; not part of normal play.

name: Minstrels (talk)
what: The minstrel troupe offers to play at your Tavern.
you: Host the feast for Coins, let them play for tips, or send them away.

name: Peddler (talk)
what: The peddler greets you and opens his wares.
you: Choose Trade to open the barter table, or leave.

name: Raid Parley
what: Before a recurring raid charges, its captain halts at the edge and waits to talk.
you: Pay tribute, persuade a truce, duel the captain alone, or refuse and fight.

name: Refugees (talk)
what: The refugee family asks to be taken in.
you: Accept, ask them to work (a Charisma roll), give food, or decline.

name: Rival Envoy (talk)
what: The rival lord's envoy states his master's business.
you: Negotiate a pact (a trade roll), befriend with a gift, insult, or dismiss.

name: Stray Dog (talk)
what: The stray dog looks up at you hopefully.
you: Feed it to adopt it, or shoo it away.

name: Wandering Traveller
what: A data-driven sample talk: a traveller trades news for bread.
you: Only spawned by the admin command /hstalk traveller; not part of normal play.

name: Raids
what: After the first raid, a raid comes every 3-4 in-game days; the warning sounds at dusk the evening before.
you: Arm and post your Guards and Archers, keep the Banner stocked, and fight beside them.

name: Goblin Thief
what: Now and then a Goblin Thief sneaks in to pickpocket, then runs rather than fights.
you: Chase it down before it escapes; it sometimes drops goblin loot.

name: Traveling Merchant
what: A merchant regularly walks to the Banner and buys your goods for Coins from a limited purse.
you: Sell goods to earn the Coins you spend on tech nodes, emblems and recruits.
